item.title: The Attention Wars: Why Netflix Is Buying the Past to Own the Future - Competitive Enterprise Institute
item.description: The old “streaming wars” are over; the “attention wars” have begun. In the new battle, Netflix’s strategic acquisition of Warner Bros’ Discovery makes perfect sense. While the streaming company has been a formidable disrupter when it comes to the distribution of content, it is still a relatively nascent competitor when it comes to content production. […]
